answers.how: The container diameter is about 86 px. Using the credit card’s approximately 44 px width gives 86 × 5.4 / 44.
The keyboard’s long dimension is about 239 px. Converted using the card scale: 239 × 5.4 / 44.
The keyboard’s short dimension is about 108 px. Converted using the card scale: 108 × 5.4 / 44.
The pen measures about 120 px end to end. Converted using the card scale: 120 × 5.4 / 44.
The middle fingertip moves approximately 71 px between 0.318 s and 0.500 s, bracketing 0.4 s. Its speed is (71 / 0.182) × (5.4 / 44).
